level.title: C1 Proficient Tamil
goals: Communicate complex ideas with level-appropriate accuracy.
Adapt spoken and written register to audience and purpose.
Interpret and produce Tamil with cultural and pragmatic awareness.

lessons.title: Public-health nuance
lessons.learn: Control cohesion, stance, collocation, and spoken–written variation in professional and academic Tamil. Apply this skill to health & doctor, choosing forms appropriate to age, relationship, and setting.

grammar.title: Public-health nuance — structure and register
grammar.explain: Control cohesion, stance, collocation, and spoken–written variation in professional and academic Tamil. Tamil is suffix-rich and normally verb-final; preserve case, agreement, tense, and politeness while linking clauses.
grammar.pattern: context + case-marked participants + qualified message + finite verb
mistakes: Do not translate English clause order mechanically or mix colloquial and formal endings without a register purpose.
